subject: S-02

The third parties it names do what other capabilities hold, each placed so on that platform: Shopify's app that customizes the checkout's pages (S02-SH-654) is CM-CHK-004, extension-point on Shopify (SH-C-049/where/SH-S-0679); WooCommerce's developers and extensions that register additional checkout fields (S02-WC-342, S02-WC-343) are CM-CHK-009, extension-point on WooCommerce (WC-C-087/boundary/WC-S-0454). subject: S-02
question: what "business entities" takes its value per
reach: cross-cutting: markets and the seller's country
reading: A reading: the point's thing is the business entity that sells: the entity a store operates as (CM-ACC-004, Zid's establishment name used in invoices, S02-ZD-208), and Shopify's several entities assigned to markets (CM-ACC-005, SH-C-005/decides/SH-S-0257). Salla, WooCommerce and BigCommerce answer only that the merchant itself sells and answers for it, the whole store (S02-SA-379, S02-WC-274, S02-BC-351), which is the merchant's standing as the seller (CM-TRU-010). The entity is held wherever a rule turns on who sells (Shopify's entity is 'used for financial products, markets, apps, and taxes', S02-V-650), the business record the architecture plan's section 3 puts under markets and the seller's country (S02-D1), so the reach is cross-cutting.
